description: This Python source file defines a security plugin for detecting JFrog-related secrets such as API Keys and Identity Tokens in code repositories. It contains a class 'JFrogDetector' that extends a base regex detector and specifies patterns to identify sensitive information related to JFrog products.

classes.name: JFrogDetector
classes.description: A detector class that scans for JFrog-related secrets by applying specific regex patterns.

methods.name: secret_type
methods.description: Returns the string 'JFrog Secrets', indicating the type of secrets this detector targets.

methods.name: denylist
methods.description: Returns a list of compiled regex patterns used to identify JFrog API Keys and Identity Tokens in code.
